_meta.about: Named map tiles for the overworld tilesheet: name -> [col, row] on the 16px grid. This is the swap layer for MAP TILES, the same idea as data/asset_shortcuts.json is for whole assets. Map plans and code should reference these names instead of raw [col, row] pairs.
_meta.biome_agnostic: All six tilesheets share one identical tile layout, so these names work for every biome. To retheme a whole map, keep the names and swap the tilesheet_shortcut (map.default_tilesheet / map.desert_tilesheet / map.snow_tilesheet).
_meta.extend: Add a name here (never a raw [col,row] in game code). Find coordinates with the labeled tilesheet or asset_sliced/tiles/<sheet>/<scale>/index.json (tile_col / tile_row).
